Thousands of women use Hormona to take control of their hormonal health.
Predict your upcoming symptoms in advance and learn how to mitigate them.

Love the app! So helpful! The more I log my symptoms, the more accurate the app is. It has gotten to the point where the app will tell me that I’m probably going to feel a certain way and I can mentally prepare myself for that. It also gives you advice on how to improve your life based on how you’re feeling, because we can’t control how we feel, but we can control how we act upon our feelings.
Brings clarity and confidence for women going through perimenopause
Finally, I understand what’s happening in my body—I'm entering perimenopause. Knowing how my hormones are changing and affecting me has given me real confidence and peace of mind.
Easy at-home hormone testing offers immediate results and a sense of control.

I wanted to know if my PMS symptoms were caused by a hormonal imbalance. I tried the Hormona’s Wellness tests and I was really impressed by how easy it was to get the results immediately on the app. I finally got the clarity I needed and the best part is that I could do this by myself without having to depend on any doctors.
Understand perimenopause symptoms and how to manage them.

The app explained why I was experiencing certain symptoms during perimenopause. It also made me feel less lonely and gave practical tips on what I could do to actually feel better, in a way my doctor never could.
